title: Fee Waivers on Credit Builder Accounts
content:
## Standard in force

1. A fee on a Credit Builder account may be waived once: a fee that already carries a fee waiver is not waived again.
2. Where a fee waiver request window applies, the window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the fee's assessment date, and a request on the last day is in time.
3. Fees caused by a Larkspur error, an unauthorized debit or a documented bank error are waived on those bases without window or count.
4. The administration fee is never waived once the account is active.

Whether a fee already carries a waiver is read from the account's entries: a fee waiver entry points at the fee it waives.

## Counting a request window (hypothetical dates)

With a window of 60 calendar days and a fee assessed on 1 June, the first day counted is 2 June and the last day of the window is 31 July. A request on 31 July is in time; a request on 1 August is not.

## Retired clauses

> A courtesy waiver is granted on request when fewer than the plan's courtesy waivers per 12 months have been granted on the account.

> A courtesy waiver must be requested no later than the fee waiver request window after the fee's assessment date.

Both clauses are no longer in force as written: they have been superseded by the current Credit Builder bases for courtesy waivers, which now govern when a courtesy waiver is granted and whether a request window applies to it.

## Points of judgement

| Fee and basis | Treatment under the clauses in force |
|---|---|
| a fee that already carries a fee waiver | not waived again |
| a fee caused by a Larkspur error | waived on that basis, with no window and no count |
| a fee caused by an unauthorized debit or a documented bank error | waived on that basis, with no window and no count |
| the administration fee on an active account | never waived |

superseded_clauses: A courtesy waiver is granted on request when fewer than the plan's courtesy waivers per 12 months have been granted on the account.
A courtesy waiver must be requested no later than the fee waiver request window after the fee's assessment date.
